## Recovered observations

40 points (from FA-47) read by two readings made separately and reconciled (batch `curves-appa-b3`, rules `docs/CURVE-READING.md (2026-10-08)`). Values are SI; the printed-unit values and the pixel coordinates on the page image are kept beside them so every point can be checked against the scan. x_read_bound and y_read_bound are reading bounds in printed units: the largest change of value over the point's pixel interval on the piecewise map, plus the location error of the two lines around it (D-025; the global calibration residual is not added, see qa/<batch>/calibration-sensitivity.md for the affine difference); x_bound_si and y_bound_si are the same in SI. They are not standard deviations.

Both readings drawn on the page image (filled circles: Claude's reading; hollow squares: Codex's; bars: pixel bounds; the canonical reading of each panel is named in the batch review). Click to enlarge.

## Notes from the two readings

- Claude: A-93 names the Burmister method but omits the sentence saying the solid line is an average with 95 percent limits; kind set by analogy with the other density charts. Limits 73.5 and 75.3 at Dr 0; all three lines meet at 89.4 at Dr 1.0 (a 75 tick label sits among the end labels). RSM-b is not among the F2-17 lines.
- Codex: Unit weights are mean minimum;maximum. No measurement points or explicit statement of averaging; limits start at 73.5 and 75.3 and meet at 89.4. AM-68-1 Vol. II, Fig. A-47, printed A-95, PDF 96
